vo_open.text: Thirty-three thousand people lived here, in a space smaller than four football fields.

vo.text: Kowloon Walled City, Hong Kong. About three hundred buildings, grown into one.
vo.cap: *Kowloon Walled City.* About *300 buildings*, grown into one.

vo.text: Up to fourteen stories. No higher, because of the airport nearby.
vo.cap: Up to *14 stories.* No higher: *the airport.*

vo.text: Almost no government control. Unlicensed dentists and doctors worked here freely.
Over one million people per square kilometer. It was demolished in 1994.
vo.cap: *1.25 million* people per km². Demolished in *1994.*
